description: Demo persona for the student vertical, authored 2026-08-26. An SC student in class 10 whose family income is well under the Pre-Matric ceiling, at a government school. A persona is demo fiction and is fine to author; scheme rules are not, and none are invented here. She is deliberately in class 10 rather than in higher education: that makes her ELIGIBLE for Pre-Matric and NOT_ELIGIBLE for Top Class on a clean, quotable numeric bound, so the vertical shows a positive match and a precise refusal without needing two personas. She declares she has NOT secured college admission, which is what rules Top Class out. That exercises the intake asymmetry on real corpus: a declaration can rule a scheme OUT even where it could never rule one IN, so she is told why rather than being sent to fetch a college admission letter she has no reason to have.
